$comment: Checks the code that calls the library (benchmarks, examples) against the library's declared types (ticket 0094): every call's argument count, array types and option strings. Not `strict`: a caller's own scratch variables need no annotations, only its calls into lib/ must type-check. lib/ itself is checked by tsconfig.json under `strict`. types/callers/ narrows three stdlib declarations that are too loose (uniform/discreteUniform return a union whatever the dtype) or that reject stdlib's own benchmark convention (bench); `paths` here replaces tsconfig.json's, so it repeats them.
